purpose: Taxonomy of user abandonment motivations for Value Plane experiments

reasons.description: User left because they could not verify if the organization was legally registered or authentic.
reasons.countermeasure: Variant A (Verified Official Institutional Data: NIT, Legal Status, Chamber of Commerce).

reasons.description: User hesitated because legal compliance/supervision status was not visible on the main page.
User wanted to see audit reports, financial statements, or impact reports before donating/acting.
reasons.countermeasure: Variant C (Public Document & Transparency Center with downloadable PDFs).

reasons.description: User could not locate the contact method or donation wire details easily.
reasons.countermeasure: Direct structured info cards with one-click copy and WCAG contrast.

reasons.description: User left without interaction or think-aloud explanation.
